electricity.formula: Cost = total_kwh × ₹8.0/kWh; Emissions = total_kwh × 0.7 kg CO₂/kWh
electricity.note: Emissions are ESTIMATED based on grid carbon factor. Actual emissions depend on real-time grid mix.

solar.formula: Offset cost = solar_kwh × ₹8.0/kWh; Avoided emissions = solar_kwh × 0.7 kg CO₂/kWh
solar.note: Avoided emissions assume solar displaces grid electricity 1:1. This may not hold during export/curtailment.

water.note: Treatment energy is an ESTIMATE of pumping and treatment energy, NOT measured electricity consumption.

waste.formula: Diversion rate = (composted + recycled) / total_waste × 100; Compost output = composted_kg / 4 (4:1 ratio)
waste.note: Compost output assumes all diverted organic waste is successfully composted at a 4:1 input-to-output ratio. Actual yield depends on composting conditions.
